question: State the brightness ratio associated with a magnitude difference of one; name two types of observations amateurs can contribute.
raw:
O1: [S5] A difference of 1.0 in magnitude corresponds to the brightness ratio of $\sqrt[5]{100}$, or about 2.512.  
O2: [S1] Two types of observations amateurs can contribute are monitoring variable stars and discovering transient astronomical events such as comets.
